metadata.description: Error pattern classification for deploy-test auto-recovery with TOON optimization

toon.fixable_locally_toon:
fixable_locally[5]{pattern,category,fix_command,severity,retry_delay,description}:
  TypeScript error TS[0-9]+:,typescript,npm run type-check && npm run build,medium,5,TypeScript compilation errors
  SyntaxError: .* in .*\.py,python_syntax,black {file} && flake8 {file},high,10,Python syntax errors
  npm ERR! Missing dependencies,npm_deps,npm ci,medium,5,Missing npm dependencies
  ModuleNotFoundError: No module named,python_deps,pip install -r requirements.txt,medium,10,Missing Python dependencies
  error: pathspec '.*' did not match any file,git_pathspec,git reset HEAD && git add -A,low,5,Git pathspec errors
toon.fixable_remotely_toon:
fixable_remotely[5]{pattern,category,fix_command,severity,retry_delay,description}:
  container .* unhealthy,container_health,docker compose restart {service},medium,30,Unhealthy Docker containers
  Database connection refused,db_connection,docker compose restart postgres && sleep 10,high,30,Database connection failures
  redis.*Connection refused,redis_connection,docker compose restart redis && sleep 5,medium,20,Redis connection failures
  port.*already allocated,port_conflict,docker compose down && docker compose up -d,medium,15,Port allocation conflicts
  network.*not found,network_missing,docker compose down && docker compose up -d,medium,20,Docker network not found
toon.not_fixable_toon:
not_fixable[5]{pattern,category,manual_action,severity,description}:
  No space left on device,disk_space,Free up disk space: docker system prune -a; docker volume prune; Check /opt/budget/logs/ for large files,critical,Disk space exhausted
  Permission denied.*sudo,sudo_permissions,Check sudo permissions: visudo -c; Verify user is in sudoers; Check /etc/sudoers.d/ files,critical,Sudo permission errors
  Permission denied.*\.git,git_permissions,Fix git repository permissions: sudo chown -R $(whoami):$(whoami) /opt/budget; chmod -R 755 /opt/budget/.git,high,Git repository permission errors
  fatal: Could not read from remote repository,git_auth,Check SSH key authentication: ssh -T git@github.com; ssh-add -l; Verify deploy key permissions,critical,Git authentication failures
  CONFLICT.*Merge conflict,merge_conflict,Resolve merge conflicts manually: git status; Edit conflicted files; git add <resolved files>; git commit,high,Git merge conflicts
